messages.subject: [knitr devel] What's the plan re: pandoc updating?
parts:
There are things to be changed for updating to rmarkdown v2. Is it going to be a case by
case in the master development branch or ???


A simple example...
This has always worked in a source Rmd...

\[
\begin{equation}

f(x) = x^2 - 1

\end{equation}
\]

but with pandoc the blank lines break the output when '-t html'.

That's not too big of a deal, and perhaps not even knitr's concern except that chunks
emit an extra newline (even with 'asis'), so any nested knitr chunk in the mathjax
environment breaks the output. (All of the xtable examples are borked.)
